# UX Requirements Checklist: Indicador de barra de desplazamiento

**Purpose**: Validate the completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, and coverage of UX requirements for proportional overflow indicators before implementation
**Created**: 2026-08-21
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements. It evaluates the written requirements, not the implementation.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all vertically scrollable container types explicitly enumerated so the phrase "cada contenedor" has a closed and reviewable scope? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK002 Are the requirements for track, thumb, available content width, outer border, and fixed rows all documented for both overflowing and fitting states? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002–FR-004, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements present for every source of the superseded directional text, including scrollable containers, Actions, Help, and final-frame overflow handling? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012, Spec §FR-017, Gap]
- [x] CHK004 Are the responsibilities of the scrollbar, existing keyboard controls, Help, and the non-scrollable Actions omission cue fully distinguished? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-016–FR-017]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Is "inmediatamente junto a su borde derecho" defined precisely enough to distinguish the scrollbar cell from padding and the outer border? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK006 Is the term "filas desplazables" unambiguous for containers with leading notices, trailing controls, wrapped errors, or other fixed content? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Spec §Definitions]
- [x] CHK007 Is the rounding rule for an exact half explicitly defined rather than relying on the ambiguous phrase "número entero más cercano"? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-005–FR-006]
- [x] CHK008 Are "posición lógica", "primera fila visible", and the position actually represented by the thumb defined consistently and with an explicit relationship? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-014, Spec §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK009 Is "distinguibles" quantified sufficiently to establish an objective textual/no-color distinction between track and thumb? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Spec §SC-006]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK010 Do the global prohibition in FR-017 and the container-specific prohibition in FR-012 establish one consistent rule for every visible `↑ more` and `↓ more` occurrence? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK011 Do the one-column placement and conditional-width requirements agree on whether existing right padding is retained, replaced, or reclaimed? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002–FR-003, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK012 Are fixed-row exclusions consistent between the clarification, acceptance scenario, functional requirement, data model, and TUI contract? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §FR-004, Data Model §Projected Section, Contract §Track Extent]
- [x] CHK013 Is Actions consistently defined as non-scrollable and bar-free while still providing complete option discoverability through Help? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 1 Scenario 4, Spec §FR-017, Spec §SC-001]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK014 Can the requirement that a bar is adjacent to the right border be assessed objectively across every named container without inferring unstated geometry? [Measurability, Spec §FR-003, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK015 Do the proportional success criteria define the exact input combinations or selection method needed to make "al menos 20 combinaciones" reproducible? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK016 Is the one-row rounding tolerance in SC-003 consistent with the exact endpoint and formula requirements, including exact-half cases? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005–FR-007, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK017 Does the participant-based criterion define a repeatable prompt, content fixture, terminal size, success classification, and timing method? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-006, Gap]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK018 Are primary requirements complete for fit, overflow-at-start, overflow-in-middle, overflow-at-end, and return-to-fit scenarios? [Coverage, Spec §User Stories 1–2, Spec §FR-001–FR-008]
- [x] CHK019 Are alternate requirements defined for simultaneous independent bars and for a modal appearing above scrollable background containers? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 3 Scenario 2, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK020 Are exception requirements defined for invalid or stale offsets after content shrink without introducing an undefined failure state? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK021 Are recovery requirements complete for crossing into and returning from the undersized view while preserving selection, focus, and logical position? [Coverage, Recovery Flow, Spec §FR-015, Spec §SC-005]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK022 Does the specification define the expected informational limitation of a one-row track where thumb position and proportion cannot both be represented? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK023 Are requirements explicit for overflow by exactly one row and for content so large that the proportional thumb would be smaller than one cell? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK024 Are width and truncation requirements complete for Unicode of variable display width after the scrollbar consumes one interior column? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-013, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK025 Are boundary requirements defined for zero usable scrollable rows or a container too narrow to hold both content and the scrollbar column? [Gap, Edge Case]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK026 Are responsiveness requirements quantified for scrollbar recalculation rather than only stating that it occurs in the same visible update? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, Plan §Performance Goals]
- [x] CHK027 Are keyboard-only and no-mouse requirements stated for every affected surface, including Help and temporary panels? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-016, Spec §Scope Boundaries]
- [x] CHK028 Are no-color and textual accessibility requirements complete for track/thumb distinction, focus cues, fixed controls, and hidden-action discoverability? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-011, Spec §FR-017, Spec §SC-006]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK029 Are inherited keyboard, focus, minimum-size, truncation, and viewport behaviors identified as normative dependencies rather than informal assumptions? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Constraints]
- [x] CHK030 Is the interpretation of "scrollwheel" as a visual indicator validated consistently against the explicit exclusion of mouse wheel, click, and drag support? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Spec §Scope Boundaries]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK031 Is precedence documented where the current specification supersedes the directional-marker requirements from feature 004 and its acceptance criteria? [Conflict, Contract §Introduction, Gap]
- [x] CHK032 Are specification-level outcomes kept distinct from plan-level glyph, arithmetic, and projection decisions so normative behavior is clear without depending on implementation choices? [Traceability, Spec §FR-004–FR-006, Plan §Technical Context, Contract §Visual Vocabulary]
